description: Declarative effect definitions normalized by the CBP rules runtime.

profile.purpose: small active-user marker and preferences only

rendering.final_operation: smoothscale native render target to centered aspect-preserving window viewport

summon_procedure.material_selector: selector predicate for eligible materials; Fusion and Ritual default to monster kinds
summon_procedure.required_card_ids: ordered or repeated authored card IDs; exact matching uses instance-safe multisets
summon_procedure.min_stars: minimum total stars for threshold procedures such as Ritual
summon_procedure.exact: boolean; exact Fusion procedures compare the selected card-ID multiset
summon_procedure.source_selector: optional selector for the summon card's source state; Fusion defaults to Extra Deck and Ritual defaults to hand
summon_procedure.source_method: provenance method recorded for the summoned card
summon_procedure.required_count: exact material count for authored tribute procedures; normal tribute tiers are loaded from data/rules.json
summon_procedure.costs: ordered reusable cost objects; discard costs can pause and resume before material selection

event_name.enabled: boolean; false or absent keeps the event non-blocking
event_name.mandatory: boolean; card response required while a legal candidate exists
event_name.allow_pass: boolean; explicit PASS override, otherwise false for mandatory policies
event_name.priority: opposite or explicitly authored priority side
event_name.phases: optional normalized phase names allowed for the response window
event_name.source_kinds: optional source-card kinds allowed for the response window
event_name.target_zones: optional target-card zones required by the response window

event_name_or_*.enabled: boolean; wildcard applies to events without an exact entry
event_name_or_*.events: optional list of allowed event names or any
event_name_or_*.phase: single phase or list of normalized phases

event_record.source_card_id: card causing or carrying the event
event_record.source_zone: source card zone at event creation
event_record.metadata: event-specific movement, damage, summon, attack, or state fields
event_record.response_window: optional metadata flag; a window opens only when the opposing priority side has a legal response
event_record.trigger_group_id: stable ID shared by effects collected for this event
event_record.trigger_group_order: effect IDs in deterministic priority/card/effect order
event_record.trigger_group_selected_order: effect IDs selected by the chooser when a group is prompted
event_record.observation_sequence: monotonic live-observation record sequence; excludes wall-clock ordering
event_record.replacement_records: ordered mutation records showing replacement IDs, operations, before, after, and amounts

event_response_window.priority: opposite side of the event actor
event_response_window.context: preserves event trigger, actor, source, targets, and event metadata

trigger_group.members: ordered effect descriptors with priority and ordering_key
trigger_group.resolved: effect IDs dispatched in the recorded order
trigger_group.selected_order: optional player or AI-selected effect order
trigger_group.included_ids: effect IDs selected for dispatch; optional effects may be omitted
trigger_group.required_ids: effect IDs that must be included
trigger_group.optional_ids: effect IDs eligible for omission when optional_effects is prompt
trigger_group.excluded_ids: optional effect IDs omitted by a none or prompt policy

trigger_order_policy.enabled: boolean; enable an order prompt when more than one effect matches
trigger_order_policy.mandatory: boolean; the selected order must include every group member
trigger_order_policy.fallback: deterministic fallback label for non-prompt paths
trigger_order_policy.order_validation: prompt selections must contain every required ID, no duplicates, and only allowed optional IDs

condition_composition.all: nested predicates that must all match
condition_composition.any: nested predicates where at least one must match
condition_composition.not: single nested predicate that must not match

notify.text: Discard one card to activate this effect.

selector.card_id: exact authored card ID or array
selector.name: exact authored card name or array

visibility.public: face-up field and graveyard/banished records are visible
visibility.hidden: opponent hand/deck/facedown identity is projected as hidden

live_observation.snapshot: viewer-scoped public state, current event records, and learned card/effect IDs for live duel spectators
live_observation.checkpoint: cbp.observation-checkpoint.v1 with canonical SHA-256 digest for inspection-state integrity
live_observation.state_checkpoint: cbp.state-checkpoint.v1 serializable zone, duel-state, chain, and supported pending-prompt payload with digest validation
live_observation.purpose: current live-duel viewer projections and diagnostics only; no record-and-rewatch playback

knowledge.effect_facts: observed trigger, action, speed, and optionality facts
knowledge.outcome_facts: future-compatible result observations; current runtime records legality and status
knowledge.import: unknown card/effect IDs are filtered against the current content registry

summon.method: special, normal, fusion, ritual, or authored method key
summon.select: selector for cards to summon from deck, hand, graveyard, banished, or another legal zone

summon_procedure.kind: tribute, fusion, ritual, or authored procedure key
summon_procedure.material_selector: shared selector predicate for eligible materials
summon_procedure.required_card_ids: exact material IDs when exact is true
summon_procedure.locations: allowed source zones such as hand and monster
summon_procedure.exact: whether the selected IDs must equal required_card_ids
summon_procedure.material_destination: graveyard or banished; unsupported destinations are blocked explicitly
summon_procedure.source_selector: optional selector for the summon card source
summon_procedure.source_method: provenance method recorded on the summon
summon_procedure.required_count: exact material count for tribute procedures
summon_procedure.costs: ordered reusable cost objects applied before material selection

grant_normal_summon.count: number of additional normal summon permissions
grant_normal_summon.per_turn: whether the grant is replenished at the owner's next turn
grant_normal_summon.cost: optional cost object, including pay_hp amount

negate_chain.reference: previous, latest, oldest, link ID, or a link selector object; the active link cannot negate itself
negate_chain.selector: optional link selector containing link_id, effect_id, trigger, actor, or speed
negate_chain.status: only pending links are legal negation targets
negate_chain.history: records source link and source effect provenance in chain history

response_cost.discard: response activation may emit choose_cards and resume as a chain link after payment
response_cost.pay_hp: response activation may pay HP before adding its chain link
response_cost.cost_paid: chain context marker preventing a resolved response from paying twice

action.target: selector id, source, actor, or explicit target

target_policy.revalidate: boolean; declarative effects default true, legacy effects preserve prior behavior
target_policy.snapshot: captured legal target IDs at selection-window creation

action.duration: instant, until_end_of_turn, per_turn, while_face_up, while_source_on_field, while_source_face_up, permanent, or phase window
action.condition: optional predicate list; summon_method, summon_source_zone, summon_source_card_id, and summon_source_effect_id are supported provenance fields

modifier_runtime.continuous: boolean; register this modifier as a runtime effect when resolved
modifier_runtime.layer: integer layer ordering; lower layers apply first
modifier_runtime.duration: expiry contract evaluated at phase/turn boundaries or from source state
modifier_runtime.replacement: optional event-value replacement object with event, operation, amount, selector, priority, and once
modifier_runtime.legality_record: resolution result contains source_present, target_ids, target_count, and status

summon_provenance.summon_method: normal, special, fusion, ritual, or authored method key
summon_provenance.summon_source_zone: deck, hand, graveyard, banished, extra, or another zone key
summon_provenance.summon_source_card_id: exact effect-card ID that caused a special summon
summon_provenance.summon_source_card_name: exact effect-card name that caused a special summon
summon_provenance.summon_source_effect_id: exact effect definition ID that caused a special summon

control.controller: actor becomes the current controller and the move emits a control event

chain.priority: side currently allowed to add a response link
chain.passes: alternating priority passes before resolving the stack
chain.negated: link state set by a valid negation effect
chain.legality: source controller, spell speed, target IDs, count, and target snapshot captured at link admission

notification.default: answer used only when an automatic policy is explicitly allowed
notification.payload: structured data for the renderer and resolver; procedure_materials payloads include procedure, card, candidate_ids, required, min_stars, locations, exact, material_destination, selected_ids, and selected_stars; chain_response payloads include chain ID, priority, and legal response card IDs

data_migration.rule: Imported effect records are normalized at load time into the canonical schema; this is a data migration boundary, not an engine compatibility promise.
